meta.title: KinHop
meta.description: KinHop: mobility, places, incidents and travel budget on a single map.

setup.title: How much do you want to spend on this trip?
setup.body: Set a budget and log each expense: you will see right away how much is left and where it goes. It is stored only here; we will never ask for your card details.

chart.title: Where it goes
chart.empty: Once you log your first expense, you will see how much goes to each category here.

history.title: History
history.empty: No expenses yet. Tap “Add expense” to log the first one: taxi, food, tickets…

form.local: I paid at a local business
form.localHint: Counts toward your local spending meter. Stored only in this browser.

errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than 0 with up to 2 decimals, for example 150 or 12.50.

local.title: Your spending that stayed in the city
local.empty: Log an expense and mark whether it was at a local business.
local.body: {local} of {total} at local businesses you marked.

auth.tagline: Discover events, places and routes in your city, and keep your trip budget in one place.
auth.demo: Sign in with the demo account
